interface_measurement.method: One run per width on the same machine, monotonic wall clock from browser upload to visible count, then text search to selected graph. CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after filtering. Includes automation waits. Heap samples are neither peaks nor per-record allocation. Viewport emulation uses desktop hardware.
interface_measurement.scope: Record cap exercised at the chosen upper boundary. Separate parser/producer tests exercise byte and field limits. No performance guarantee for a 4 MiB comparison or other machines.

accepted_fixtures.referee_pin_assurance: Same fixture supplied the archive digest. Pin establishes byte consistency only.
